FLAGELLANT-FLAGELLANT_STRIKE.title: Strike
FLAGELLANT-FLAGELLANT_DEFEND.title: Defend
FLAGELLANT-PUNISH.title: Punish
FLAGELLANT-PUNISH.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Apply {PoisonPower:diff()} [gold]Poison[/gold].
Lose {LossPercent:diff()}%({LossCurrentHp:diff()}) current HP. {IfUpgraded:show:
Apply {ComboPower:comboIcons()}.}
FLAGELLANT-FESTER.title: Fester
FLAGELLANT-FESTER.description:
Gain {StressPower:diff()} [gold]Stress[/gold].
Apply {VulnerablePower:diff()} [gold]Vulnerable[/gold].
If the target has {ComboPower:comboIcons()}, draw {Cards:diff()} card and heal {HealingPercent:diff()}%({HealingMaxHp:diff()}) HP.
FLAGELLANT-EXECUTION.title: Execution
FLAGELLANT-EXECUTION.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Apply {PoisonPower:diff()} [gold]Poison[/gold].
Heal {HealingPercent:diff()}%({HealingMaxHp:diff()}) HP.{IfUpgraded:show:
Apply {ComboPower:comboIcons()}.}
FLAGELLANT-RAPTUROUS.title: Rapturous
FLAGELLANT-RAPTUROUS.description:
Whenever you gain [gold]Stress[/gold], gain {RapturousPower:diff()} additional [gold]Stress[/gold].
At the end of your turn, lose {RapturousPower:diff()} [gold]Stress[/gold].
FLAGELLANT-DEATHLESS.title: Deathless
FLAGELLANT-ENDURE.title: Endure
FLAGELLANT-ENDURE.description:
At the start of your turn, gain {StressPower:diff()} [gold]Stress[/gold].
Whenever you take unblocked damage during your turn, gain {StressPower:diff()} [gold]Stress[/gold].
FLAGELLANT-LASHS_GIFT.title: Lash's Gift
FLAGELLANT-LASHS_GIFT.description:
Gain {RegenPower:diff()} [gold]Regen[/gold].
Gain {StressPower:diff()} [gold]Stress[/gold].
The next {AddComboPower:diff()} Attack {AddComboPower:plural:card|cards} you play {AddComboPower:plural:applies|apply} {ComboPower:comboIcons()}.
FLAGELLANT-ACID_RAIN.title: Acid Rain
FLAGELLANT-ACID_RAIN.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage and apply {PoisonPower:diff()} [gold]Poison[/gold] to all enemies.
Increase damage and [gold]Poison[/gold] by {ComboUpgraded:diff()} if has {ComboPower:comboIcons()}.
Lose {LossPercent:diff()}%({LossCurrentHp:diff()}) current HP.
FLAGELLANT-MORE_MORE.title: More! More!
FLAGELLANT-MORE_MORE.description: At the start of your turn, gain {MoreMorePower:diff()} [gold]Regen[/gold].
FLAGELLANT-SUFFER.title: Suffer
FLAGELLANT-SUFFER.description: Whenever you gain [gold]Stress[/gold], heal {HealingPercent:diff()}%({HealingMaxHp:diff()}) HP and remove that much [gold]Doom[/gold].
FLAGELLANT-SEPSIS.title: Sepsis
FLAGELLANT-SEPSIS.description:
Trigger the target's [gold]Poison[/gold] {TriggerPoison:diff()} times{InCombat:({CalculatedPoisonDamage:diff()})|}.  
If the target has {ComboPower:comboIcons()}, trigger it one additional time.
FLAGELLANT-UNDYING.title: Undying
FLAGELLANT-NECROSIS.title: Necrosis
FLAGELLANT-NECROSIS.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to all enemies.
For each enemy with [gold]Poison[/gold], gain {RegenPower:diff()} [gold]Regen[/gold].
FLAGELLANT-PAIN_STRIKE.title: Pain Strike
FLAGELLANT-PAIN_STRIKE.description:
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage.
Deals {Multiplier:diff()} additional damage for each [gold]Stress[/gold] you have.
FLAGELLANT-FATAL_STRIKE.title: Fatal Strike
FLAGELLANT-FATAL_STRIKE.description:
Deal damage equal to your lost HP{InCombat:({CalculatedDamage:diff()})|}.
Lose {StressPower:diff()} [gold]Stress[/gold].
FLAGELLANT-CRIPPLING_STRIKE.title: Crippling Strike
FLAGELLANT-CRIPPLING_STRIKE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Apply {PoisonPower:diff()} [gold]Poison[/gold].
Draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
Lose {LossPercent:diff()}%({LossCurrentHp:diff()}) current HP.
FLAGELLANT-SCOURGE_FORM.title: Scourge Form
FLAGELLANT-SCOURGE_FORM.description:
Increase the HP percentage you are set to when entering [gold]Toxic[/gold] by {AdditionalHpPercent}%.
Gain {ToxicFormPower:diff()} [gold]Toxic Form[/gold].
FLAGELLANT-EXANIMATE_FORM.title: Exanimate Form
FLAGELLANT-EXANIMATE_FORM.description: Whenever you gain [gold]Stress[/gold], apply {ExanimateFormPower:diff()} [gold]Poison[/gold] to all enemies.
FLAGELLANT-MANIAC_FORM.title: Maniac Form
FLAGELLANT-MANIAC_FORM.description: Whenever you enter [gold]Toxic[/gold], gain {Energy:energyIcons()} and draw {ManiacFormPower:diff()} {ManiacFormPower:plural:card|cards}.
FLAGELLANT-SCOURGE.title: Scourge
FLAGELLANT-SCOURGE.description: Heal HP equal to your [gold]Doom[/gold], apply that much [gold]Poison[/gold] to all enemies.
FLAGELLANT-SPREADING_PLAGUE.title: Spreading Plague
FLAGELLANT-SPREADING_PLAGUE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If the target doesn't have [gold]Poison[/gold], apply {PoisonPower:diff()} [gold]Poison[/gold] instead.
FLAGELLANT-BLOOD_DONATION.title: Blood Donation
FLAGELLANT-BLOOD_DONATION.description:
Deal damage equal to {HealingPercent:diff()}% of your max HP to all enemies{InCombat:({CalculatedDamage:diff()})|({HealingMaxHp:diff()})}.
Lose {LossPercent:diff()}%({LossCurrentHp:diff()}) current HP.
FLAGELLANT-ANEMIA.title: Anemia
FLAGELLANT-ANEMIA.description: Whenever you lose HP for the first time during your turn, draw {AnemiaPower:diff()} {AnemiaPower:plural:card|cards}.
FLAGELLANT-SACRIFICE.title: Sacrifice
FLAGELLANT-SACRIFICE.description: Whenever you lose HP for the first time during your turn, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
FLAGELLANT-PILGRIMAGE.title: Pilgrimage
FLAGELLANT-PILGRIMAGE.description:
Draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
If you have taken unblocked damage this turn, draw {ExtraDraw:diff()} additional {ExtraDraw:plural:card|cards}.
FLAGELLANT-BLACK_BLOOD.title: Black Blood
FLAGELLANT-BLACK_BLOOD.description: Whenever you take unblocked damage during your turn, deal that much damage to all enemies.
FLAGELLANT-ABSORB_PAIN.title: Absorb Pain
FLAGELLANT-WYRD_RECONSTRUCTION.title: Wyrd Reconstruction
FLAGELLANT-WYRD_RECONSTRUCTION.descripti:
Heal {HealingPercent:diff()}%({HealingMaxHp:diff()}) HP.
If your HP is 30% or less, heal {HealingPercentLow:diff()}%({HealingMaxHpLow:diff()}) instead.
FLAGELLANT-HARDER.title: Harder!
FLAGELLANT-HARDER.description:
Heal {HealingPercent:diff()}%({HealingMaxHp:diff()}) HP{IfUpgraded:show:, remove that much [gold]Doom[/gold]}.
Draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
FLAGELLANT-RAPID_HEALING.title: Rapid Healing
FLAGELLANT-RAPID_HEALING.description:
Heal {HealingPercent:diff()}%({HealingMaxHp:diff()}) HP.
If your HP is 30% or less, gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] first.
FLAGELLANT-LASH.title: Lash
FLAGELLANT-LASH.description:
Lose {LossPercent:diff()}%({LossCurrentHp:diff()}) current HP.
Gain {RegenPower:diff()} [gold]Regen[/gold].
Repeat {Repeat:diff()} times.
FLAGELLANT-DEATH_COMES.title: Death Comes
FLAGELLANT-DEATH_COMES.description:
Gain {StressPower:diff()} [gold]Stress[/gold].
Gain [gold]Doom[/gold] equal to your current HP.
FLAGELLANT-FEAR_ERUPTION.title: Fear Eruption
FLAGELLANT-FEAR_ERUPTION.description:
Gain {StressPower:diff()} [gold]Stress[/gold].
Deal damage equal to your [gold]Stress[/gold] to all enemies{InCombat:({CalculatedDamage:diff()})|}.
FLAGELLANT-MEDITATION.title: Meditation
FLAGELLANT-COERCE.title: Coerce
FLAGELLANT-COERCE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Costs 1 less {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} for each time you gain [gold]Stress[/gold] this turn.
FLAGELLANT-NERVOUS.title: Nervous
FLAGELLANT-SPREADING_ANXIETY.title: Spreading Anxiety
FLAGELLANT-SPREADING_ANXIETY.description:
Gain {StressPower:diff()} [gold]Stress[/gold].
All enemies lose [gold]Strength[/gold] equal to your [gold]Stress[/gold] this turn.
FLAGELLANT-SELF_DESTRUCTION.title: Self Destruction
FLAGELLANT-UNYIELDING.title: Unyielding
FLAGELLANT-UNYIELDING.description: Prevent the next {UnyieldingPower:diff()} {UnyieldingPower:plural:time|times} you would gain [gold]Doom[/gold].
FLAGELLANT-DOOMED_CONSTITUTION.title: Doomed Constitution
FLAGELLANT-DOOMED_CONSTITUTION.descripti: Whenever you lose HP, apply that much [gold]Doom[/gold] to all enemies.
FLAGELLANT-TRANSFER_MISFORTUNE.title: Transfer Misfortune
FLAGELLANT-TRANSFER_MISFORTUNE.descripti:
Remove {DoomPower:diff()} [gold]Doom[/gold].
Apply {DoomPower:diff()} [gold]Doom[/gold] to all enemies.
Draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
FLAGELLANT-HOLD_THE_LINE.title: Hold The Line
FLAGELLANT-HOLD_THE_LINE.description: Whenever {ComboPower:comboIcons()} you apply is triggered or overwritten, draw {HoldTheLinePower:diff()} {HoldTheLinePower:plural:card|cards}.
FLAGELLANT-GIVE_NO_QUARTER.title: Give No Quarter
FLAGELLANT-GIVE_NO_QUARTER.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If the target has {ComboPower:comboIcons()}, the next {GiveNoQuarterPower:diff()} {GiveNoQuarterPower:plural:card|cards} you play {GiveNoQuarterPower:plural:costs|cost} 0{energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}.
FLAGELLANT-OVERDRAW_LIFE.title: Overdraw Life
FLAGELLANT-MARTYRDOM.title: Martyrdom
FLAGELLANT-MARTYRDOM.description:
Deal damage equal to your [gold]Doom[/gold] to all enemies{InCombat:({CalculatedDamage:diff()})|}.
Lose HP equal to your [gold]Doom[/gold].
Remove all your [gold]Doom[/gold].
FLAGELLANT-BATTLEFIELD_MEDICINE.title: Battlefield Medicine
FLAGELLANT-BACK_TO_THE_PIT.title: Back To The Pit
FLAGELLANT-BACK_TO_THE_PIT.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Costs 1 less {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} for each time you take unblocked damage this turn.
FLAGELLANT-BLOOD_WAVE.title: Blood Wave
FLAGELLANT-BLOOD_WAVE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Heal {HealingPercent:diff()}%({HealingMaxHp:diff()}) HP. If you don't have [gold]Regen[/gold], gain {RegenPower:diff()} [gold]Regen[/gold] instead.
FLAGELLANT-RESTRAINT.title: Restraint
FLAGELLANT-RESTRAINT.description:
Gain {StressPower:diff()} [gold]Stress[/gold].
Lose {LossPercent:diff()}%({LossCurrentHp:diff()}) current HP.
Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} and draw {Cards:diff()} card next turn.
FLAGELLANT-TRUDGE.title: Trudge
FLAGELLANT-WEIGHT_TRAINING.title: Weight Training
FLAGELLANT-WEIGHT_TRAINING.description: Whenever you heal HP, heal {WeightTrainingPower:diff()} additional HP.
FLAGELLANT-CORPSE_INSTABILITY.title: Corpse Instability
FLAGELLANT-CORPSE_INSTABILITY.descriptio: Whenever your HP changes this turn, apply {CorpseInstabilityPower:diff()} [gold]Poison[/gold] to all enemies.
FLAGELLANT-BREAKING_DEAD.title: Breaking Dead
FLAGELLANT-BREAKING_DEAD.description: Whenever you apply [gold]Poison[/gold] to enemies, apply {BreakingDeadPower:diff()} additional [gold]Poison[/gold].
FLAGELLANT-BONE_MELTING_PALM.title: Bone Melting Palm
FLAGELLANT-BONE_MELTING_PALM.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Remove all [gold]Doom[/gold] from the target and apply that much [gold]Poison[/gold].
FLAGELLANT-BLISS.title: Bliss
FLAGELLANT-BLISS.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Whenever you take unblocked damage this turn, gain {BlissPower:diff()} [gold]Stress[/gold] and {BlissPower:diff()} [gold]Regen[/gold].
FLAGELLANT-RIPOSTE.title: Riposte
FLAGELLANT-RIPOSTE.description:
Lose {LossPercent:diff()}%({LossCurrentHp:diff()}) current HP.
Deal damage equal to the HP lost{InCombat:({CalculatedDamage:diff()})|} to a random enemy {Repeat:diff()} times.
FLAGELLANT-CHEAT_DEATH.title: Cheat Death
FLAGELLANT-ANNIHILATE.title: Annihilate
FLAGELLANT-ANNIHILATE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If the target has {ComboPower:comboIcons()}, deal {ComboDamage:diff()} damage instead.
FLAGELLANT-SUFFER_ALONE.title: Suffer Alone
FLAGELLANT-SETBACKS_TO_COURAGE.title: Setbacks To Courage
FLAGELLANT-SETBACKS_TO_COURAGE.descripti:
Gain {StressPower:diff()} [gold]Stress[/gold].
Draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
Increase this card's [gold]Stress[/gold] by 1, increase this card's cost by 1{energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}.
FLAGELLANT-BEYOND_CURE.title: Beyond Cure
FLAGELLANT-PSYCHOLOGY_CONSULTING.title: Psychology Consulting
FLAGELLANT-PSYCHOLOGY_CONSULTING.descrip:
Remove all your [gold]Stress[/gold], heal HP equal to {Multiplier:diff()} times your [gold]Stress[/gold]{InCombat:({CalculatedHealing:diff()})|}.
Draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
FLAGELLANT-DESPERATE_FIGHT.title: Desperate Fight
FLAGELLANT-DESPERATE_FIGHT.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Heal {HealingPercent:diff()}%({HealingMaxHp:diff()}) HP.
If your HP is 30% or less, gain {StressPower:diff()} [gold]Stress[/gold] first.
FLAGELLANT-BEING_TOWARDS_DEATH.title: Being Towards Death
FLAGELLANT-BEING_TOWARDS_DEATH.descripti: Deal damage equal to the total damage you have dealt to yourself.{InCombat:({CalculatedDamage:diff()})|}
FLAGELLANT-PURIFY_MIND.title: Purify Mind
FLAGELLANT-PENANCE.title: Penance
FLAGELLANT-PENANCE.description:
Gain {StressPower:diff()} [gold]Stress[/gold].
Draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
Lose {LossPercent:diff()}%({LossCurrentHp:diff()}) current HP.
FLAGELLANT-GOSPEL.title: Gospel
FLAGELLANT-GOSPEL.description: Whenever you heal HP, apply that much [gold]Doom[/gold] to all enemies.
FLAGELLANT-ATONEMENT.title: Atonement
FLAGELLANT-ATONEMENT.description: Transfer all [gold]Vulnerable[/gold], [gold]Weak[/gold], [gold]Frail[/gold], and [gold]Doom[/gold] from another player to you.
FLAGELLANT-REDEMPTION.title: Redemption
FLAGELLANT-REDEMPTION.description:
All players gain {RegenPower:diff()} [gold]Regen[/gold].
Lose {LossPercent:diff()}%({LossCurrentHp:diff()}) current HP.
FLAGELLANT-LUNATIC_STRIKE.title: Lunatic Strike
FLAGELLANT-LUNATIC_STRIKE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Gain {StressPower:diff()} [gold]Stress[/gold]. If your HP is 30% or less, gain {StressPowerLow:diff()} [gold]Stress[/gold] instead.
FLAGELLANT-MENTAL_DEVIATION.title: Mental Deviation
FLAGELLANT-MENTAL_DEVIATION.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to all enemies.
For each enemy with {ComboPower:comboIcons()}, gain {StressPower:diff()} [gold]Stress[/gold].
FLAGELLANT-RELIEVED_STRIKE.title: Relieved Strike
FLAGELLANT-RELIEVED_STRIKE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If your [gold]Stress[/gold] is {StressPower:diff()} or more, gain {Energy:energyIcons()} and draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
FLAGELLANT-SELF_CULTIVATION.title: Self Cultivation
FLAGELLANT-RESILIENT_STRIKE.title: Resilient Strike
FLAGELLANT-RESILIENT_STRIKE.description:
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage.
Deals 1 additional damage for each [gold]Stress[/gold] you gained this combat.
FLAGELLANT-METAMORPHOSIS.title: Metamorphosis
FLAGELLANT-METAMORPHOSIS.description: If your [gold]Stress[/gold] is {StressPower:diff()} or more, gain {StressPower:diff()} [gold]Stress[/gold].
FLAGELLANT-EXPLODE_IN_SILENCE.title: Explode In Silence
FLAGELLANT-CALM_STRIKE.title: Calm Strike
FLAGELLANT-CALM_STRIKE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If your [gold]Stress[/gold] is less than {StressPower:diff()}, apply {ComboPower:comboIcons()}.
FLAGELLANT-GET_ON_YOU.title: Get On You
FLAGELLANT-GET_ON_YOU.description:
All players gain {StrengthPower:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold] this turn.
If you are in [gold]Toxic[/gold], apply {PoisonPower:diff()} [gold]Poison[/gold] to all players.
Gain {StressPower:diff()} [gold]Stress[/gold].
FLAGELLANT-UNTIL_DEATH.title: Until Death
FLAGELLANT-WAR_FEEDS_WAR.title: War Feeds War
FLAGELLANT-WAR_FEEDS_WAR.description: Whenever you gain {GainStressAmount:diff()} [gold]Stress[/gold], the next Attack card you play applies {ComboPower:comboIcons()}.
FLAGELLANT-SAMSARA.title: Samsara
FLAGELLANT-SAMSARA.description:
Swap your current HP and lost HP.
At the start of your next turn, gain HP equal to the opposite of your changed HP.
FLAGELLANT-TOXIC_JUDGEMENT.title: Toxic Judgement
FLAGELLANT-TOXIC_JUDGEMENT.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Apply [gold]Poison[/gold] equal to 50% of the target's [gold]Poison[/gold] to all enemies.
Lose {LossPercent:diff()}%({LossCurrentHp:diff()}) current HP.
FLAGELLANT-BLOODY_FLAIL.title: Bloody Flail
FLAGELLANT-PRACTICE.title: Practice
FLAGELLANT-PRACTICE.description:
Heal {HealingPercent:diff()}%({HealingMaxHp:diff()}) HP.
Add a [gold]{IfUpgraded:show:Penance+|Penance}[/gold] to your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
FLAGELLANT-FANTASY.title: Fantasy
FLAGELLANT-FANTASY.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If your [gold]Stress[/gold] is {StressPower:diff()} or more, or you are in [gold]Toxic[/gold], hits {Repeat:diff()} times.
FLAGELLANT-PENANCE_STRIKE.title: Penance Strike
FLAGELLANT-PENANCE_STRIKE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Add a [gold]Penance[/gold] to your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
If the target has {ComboPower:comboIcons()}, add {CreateCards:diff()} [gold]Penance+[/gold] instead.
FLAGELLANT-BITTER_TO_SWEET.title: Bitter To Sweet
FLAGELLANT-BITTER_TO_SWEET.description:
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage.
Deals {ExtraDamage:diff()} additional damage for each [gold]Penance[/gold] in your [gold]Exhaust Pile[/gold].
FLAGELLANT-BIDE.title: Bide
